column1: # arc UN: the set-operation matrix (TestArcUNSetOperationMatrix). id, disposition, the answer every answering arm gives, PostgreSQL 17.11's answer, the arms that refuse (each refusal identical at the base). PostgreSQL's answer to a count read (`one`, `zero`) is measured with the set operation fenced, `SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT v FROM <body> OFFSET 0) q WHERE <predicate>`, which is ADR-0012's configured oracle: unfenced, PostgreSQL's planner pushes the text predicate into each arm before the deduplication (18 of the 648 count cells answer differently; the other 630 answer alike).
